name: Canyon Grail CF 7
why_interesting: Exact official global gravel build and imagery; mainland purchase, price and warranty remain unresolved.

price_status: Official China product page showed CNY 13,700 on 2026-09-25, reduced from CNY 14,700; member-only page requires size selection. Estimated delivery/packaging is CNY 749 and VAT/customs are excluded. Selected-size stock and final landed total remain unverified.
required_before_dashboard: Dated mainland-China RMB observation and purchase route; Exact mainland SKU, stock, duties/returns and warranty handling

observed_price.price_basis: official China page and an official promotional crawl that could not be reproduced on page open

support_note: Canyon China's current policy gives a 2-year warranty for Canyon-designed frame/fork/handlebar/seatpost and original components (subject to their maker's terms), plus a 6-year non-transferable guarantee for Canyon-designed parts for the original owner; both cover delivery-time material/workmanship defects. Eligible claims include covered reassembly, shipping and customs, while collision, wear, corrosion and misuse exclusions apply. This is the brand policy for the current China route, not confirmation of a particular bike's purchase date or claim eligibility.
source_note: The direct China manufacturer page was reopened 2026-09-25: it shows CNY 13,700 with CNY 14,700 crossed out, requires member access, and provides size selection. It estimates CNY 749 delivery/packaging but excludes VAT and customs; no order was submitted, so selected-size stock and final landed cost remain unverified. The earlier 2026-08-17 CNY 11,700 promotional crawl was not reproduced and is retained in prior_price_observations.
